name: SOTERI SKIN
long_description:
Soteri Skin is D2C skincare for chronic skin conditions like eczema. We’re the only non-prescription product proven to provide long-lasting relief for the 30 million Americans who suffer from eczema.

How it works:
Skin surface pH is constantly in flux, and many of your daily activities can throw it out of balance. People with chronic skin conditions such as eczema have a harder time regulating their skin's pH. 

Soteri's patented pH/LOCK™ locks skin in at a therapeutic pH for 12+ hours, which is shown to help break the cycle of skin sensitivity, whether you have eczema, psoriasis, or just a bad sunburn.

Our formulations are aesthetically elegant (non-sticky, sit well under makeup, etc), safe for anyone to use, and don't require a prescription. Most people see skin health improvements within the first few weeks of application, even for tricky, chronic skin conditions like eczema and psoriasis.

With Soteri Skin, anyone can enjoy healthy, glowing, pH-enomenal skin!

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer: Soteri provides steroid-free OTC medications and skincare products for people suffering from eczema. Our patent-pending formulation uniquely “locks in” the skin surface in a state that is therapeutic for eczema. No other eczema treatment combines healing and preventive capabilities without negative side effects. Our mission is to help people with chronic skin conditions rediscover the joy and confidence of having happy, healthy skin.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: My background is in product and business development. I received Ph.D. in Biomedical Chemistry and Molecular Pharmacology from Harvard Medical School and went on to complete my postdoctoral fellowship at UC Berkeley. Later I worked for biopharma identifying business opportunities in the rare disease space. Before launching Soteri Skin, I spent 7 years leading a product innovation team at L'Oreal where I helped to launch and grow L'Oreal Tech Incubator in San Francisco.
